observations: Viewed assets/panels/06-2.png and its place in page-06.png. The specialist matches vision-cast.png: thin rimless rectangular glasses, bushy salt-and-pepper brows, long face with deep smile lines, neat grey moustache, greying temples, light grey blazer over a pale blue shirt, stethoscope around his neck and not in use.
Hands match the record. His right hand (screen-left) is an open palm in a welcoming gesture with five clear fingers, and his left hand hangs relaxed and empty at his side.

The vision separation is clear. A soft pale-blue rounded vignette border surrounds the art, the palette is airy and light, and dotted lines link three small clinic silhouettes in the sky. This distinguishes it from the present-day 06-1 and 06-4. The modern clinic has no signage, logos or text.

Composition note for the lettering stage, not an artwork defect: in page-06.png the panel crop plus the large narration box hide the welcoming hand, the clinic entrance and most of the dotted connections. Only the specialist and part of one silhouette link remain visible, which weakens the 'connected clinics' idea in the page as composed.
Nothing suggests diagnosis or treatment. The specialist only welcomes, which fits the 'vision only' framing in the source.
